note: Facilitator-only teaching library. Served from an authenticated endpoint. Never ship inside the page.

tensions.Command|Administration: One of these takes hold of people. The other takes hold of the process. Both of them are you deciding that someone else's way isn't good enough.
tensions.Command|Apostleship: One of these builds a following. The other keeps walking away from one. Ask who is left standing where you used to be.
tensions.Command|Discernment: You see it before anyone else does, and you say it before anyone else is ready. Neither of those waited for evidence.
tensions.Command|Evangelism: One of these opens a door. The other pushes people through it. From the outside they can look identical.
tensions.Command|Exhortation: Both of these push. Only one of them pushes because it believes in the person. Decide which one is doing the pushing today.
tensions.Command|Faith: One of these gets its authority from you. The other gets it from God. Both make you move before other people are ready.
tensions.Command|Giving: One of these takes hold. The other lets go. Watch what happens when the giving arrives with instructions attached.
tensions.Command|Healing: One of these needs people strong. The other meets them at their weakest. Which one shows up first when someone is hurting?
tensions.Command|Interpretation: One of these carries a message that was never yours. The other is used to the words being your own. Notice when the translation starts sounding like you.
tensions.Command|Knowledge: One of these keeps digging. The other has already decided. Ask yourself which one usually finishes first.
tensions.Command|Leadership: These two look like the same gift and they are not. One of them takes the room. The other takes the room somewhere.
tensions.Command|Mercy: One of these holds a standard. The other holds a person. You will be asked to do both inside the same conversation.
tensions.Command|Miracles: Both of these expect something to move. Only one of them is expecting God to move it. Be sure you know which one you are standing on.
tensions.Command|Pastor/Shepherd: One of these protects the flock. The other is willing to disturb it. Both of them believe they are keeping people safe.
tensions.Command|Prophecy: One of these has authority of its own. The other is only carrying someone else's. When you say the hard thing, people cannot tell which is speaking — and sometimes neither can you.
tensions.Command|Service: One of these steps forward. The other steps out of sight. Notice which one you reach for when nobody is watching.
tensions.Command|Teaching: One of these explains until it lands. The other expects it to land the first time. Both of them are certain they are right.
tensions.Command|Tongues: One of these takes control. The other gives it up entirely. There is no version of you doing both at once.
tensions.Command|Wisdom: One of these knows what to say. The other knows when. You have rarely had trouble with the first.
